name: Tutankhamun
source:
"S-S-S-S-S-Sorry... I-I'll just be in my Sacrophagus sleeping..."

Based on Tutankhamun, who was an Egyptian pharaoh of the 18th dynasty (ruled ca. 1332–1323 BC in the conventional chronology), during the period of Egyptian history known as the New Kingdom.

An Egyptian hero who is extremely introverted and shy. Tutankhamun normally shuts herself away in her Sacrophagus deep inside a pyramid. She hardly shows herself in front of other people, even when she talks or moves.

Because of that, her people consider her to be a rare character and deify her. She longs to get over her shyness and become an august leader.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char15a]English official site[/url]]
